data.why: The repository ships examples/example_fabricated.csv, a fabricated Source Data table with duplicated SD/SEM values and repeated panel vectors matching the detectors the app screens for; the app also has a built-in 'Run built-in demo' button that generates its own synthetic paper with no upload needed.

goals: Upload a paper's Source Data CSV/Excel file and run an initial numerical anomaly screen before manual review
Identify duplicate or rounded-duplicate data vectors across figure panels
Check for constant offsets, constant ratios, or suspiciously perfect linear relationships between groups
Check summary statistics (SD/SEM/n) for internal consistency and repeated error values
Enter target figures or panels named in a case note or retraction notice and see whether they are matched and flagged
Download a structured risk/review-priority report (HTML, JSON, CSV, or ZIP) to hand off for human review

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose accurately: a first numerical screen of Source Data that produces a ranked queue for human review. Its phases and tasks follow the README's workflow at a sensible depth, and the screens I opened support the nodes. Before filing, it needs one false claim corrected in a feature (that table settings carry over between runs), plus the missing coverage/inventory task and processing-log feature, and a tighter evidence citation for t10.
